   OLD TOWN LA VERNE BUSINESS IMPROVEMENT DISTIRICT
  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  Monday, June 2, 2025

  1.  WELCOME AND CALL TO ORDER

  The meeting began at 8:33 a.m.

  Advisory Board Members present: Craig Walters, Micky Rehm, George Henderson, and
  Marianne Stark. Advisory Board Members not present: Zuhey Espinoza.
  City Representatives present: Community Development Director Eric Scherer, City
  Manager Ken Domer, Mayor Tim Hepburn, and Secretary Natalie Hiatt. Others present:
  Fang Wang, Ken Valmonte, Randy Sharp, Anna Valiente Gomez and Wendy Norton.

2.  CALENDAR
  Annual Protest Hearing  Monday, June 2nd 6:30pm
  Beer Walk  Saturday, September 20th 5pm-8:30pm

3.  APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES March 3, 2025, April 7, 2025 and May 5, 2025

  It was moved by Mr. Henderson and seconded by Ms. Stark to approve the minutes of
  March 3, 2025, April 7, 2025 and May 5, 2025. Minutes approved by a 4-0 vote.

4.  NEW BUSINESS

  A.  Beer Walk – Chairperson Walters stated that the Association met to discuss Beer
  Walk. The event will take place September 20, 2025. There was also discussion of
  a possible street closure on D Street between Bonita Avenue and 2nd Street.

  Mr. Scherer stated that a street closure will require a traffic control plan.

  B.  New District Meeting Dates – Chairperson Walters stated that this is the last
  meeting as currently formed. The Association will now become the advisory
  board for District matters.

  Mr. Scherer stated that per the municipal code the meetings are to be held
  quarterly. He suggested changing the meetings to the second month of each
  quarter on the first Monday.

  It was moved by Mr. Henderson and seconded by Ms. Rehm to approve the new
  meeting date as stated by Mr. Scherer. Motion carried by a 4-0 vote.

5.  CONTINUED BUSINESS

  A.  District/Association Bylaws – Mr. Scherer stated that the bylaws were last
  updated in 2002. Chairperson Walters stated that the Association discussed and
   began drafting new bylaws. Changes are still being made and more discussion is
  needed at the next Association meeting.

6.  COMMITTEE REPORTS/ UPDATES

  A. City Report (Eric Scherer): Mr. Domer stated that the second hearing of the budget
  reading will review and re-evaluate services. Mr. Domer also stated that a Baldwin
  Park Police Officer was killed in the line of duty and the La Verne Police Department
  assisted in the response. There will be a grand opening ceremony for the Metro A
  Line on June 21, 2025 at the new station. The invitation email will be shared with the
  group for those interested in attending.

  B. University Report (Zuhey Espinoza): Mr. Sharp stated that the University will
  increase security on campus with the opening of the Metro line. During the summer
  months the University will host high school and college camps. There will also be
  some remodeling in preparation for the new school year.

  Mr. Scherer announced that University’s Dinner Crawl is scheduled for August 28,
  2025. More information will be provided to the group as it gets closer.

  C. Marketing (Micky Rehm): Ms. Rehm stated that she is finalizing the Wine Walk
  numbers.

  D. Chamber Report: None

  E. Social Media Update (Micky Rehm): None

  F. Financial Report: Chairperson Walters stated that the Walk of Fame is moving
  forward. More discussion will take place on the paver design. The first block will be
  unveiled at the Holiday Stroll event.

7.  PUBLIC COMMENT (Any discussion or action on non-agendized items must be
  deferred to the following meeting, as required by California Brown Act Law)

  Mayor Hepburn stated that Metro has stepped up safety, cleaning and security. More
  information to come on the opening.

8.  ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting was adjourned at 9:07am, the next regular meeting to be held on August 4,
  2025 at 8:30 a.m. at Café Wang – 2316 D Street, La Verne CA 91750.

  Respectively submitted,

  _____________________
  Natalie Hiatt
minutes_text:
OLD TOWN LA VERNE BUSINESS IMPROVEMENT DISTIRICT
  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  Monday, August 4,2025

1. WELCOME AND CALL TO ORDER
  The meeting began at 8:32 a.m.

  Advisory Board Members present: Craig Walters, Micky Rehm, George Henderson, and
  Marianne Stark. Advisory Board Members not present: Ztthey Espinoza.
  City Representatives present: Community Development Director Eric Scherer, City
  Manager Ken Domer, Councilmember Steve Johnson, and Secretary Natalie Hiatt. Others
  present: Fang Wang, Ken Valmonte, Cindy Vallejo-Victoria, Francisco Ramirez, Roy
  Cannizzo, Roberta Virgin and Wendy Norton.

2. CALENDAR
  Beer Walk  Cancelled
  Halloween Trick or Treat  Friday, October 3l't 3pm-6pm
  Holiday Stroll  Saturday, December 13th 3pm

3. APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES June2,2025
  It was moved by Ms. Stark and seconded by Mr. Henderson to approve the minutes of
  June 2, 2025. Minutes approved by a 4-0 vote-

4. NEW BUSINESS
  A. University Dinner Crawl - Ms. Vatlejo-Victoria Director of the University's Student
  Engagement and Leadership Department announced that the Dinner Crawl will be
  held Thursday, August 28th from 4pm-6pm. Ms. Vallejo-Victoria is seeking 6-7
  restaurants to participate. She estimates 200-300 students will participate. More
  information will be emailed to the group.

  The BID group agreed to provide a band at Mainiero Square for the Dinner Crawl
  event.

  Ms. Vallejo-Victoria announced that August 15m is the offrcial move-in day

5. CONTINUED BUSINESS
   A. Sidewalk Dining Policy Update - Mr. Scherer stated that the City is in the process of
  making changes to the policy and January 1,2026 is the new implementation date.
  Major changes include a flat rate charge instead of a per square foot charge.

  B. Walk of Honor Update - Chairperson Walters announced that the group is moving
  forward with the Walk of Honor Program and recognizing l0 individuals. The paver
  design will pay homage to the Pride of La Verne citrus label. Each paver will be l5
  inches square, black marble, and will recognize an individual, couple, or organization
  for their community involvement. The pavers are expected to be installed by the
  Holiday Stroll event.

  C. Street Light Banners Update - Ms. Rehm stated that she is working with Courier
  Printing and in the process of deciding on a banner design. The group is also
  considering selling banners to Old Town businesses for advertising.

  Mr. Scherer stated that the brackets arrived about two weeks ago. The Public Works
  Department will be responsible for the installation.

6. COMMITTEE REPORTS/ UPDATES
  A. City Report (Eric Scherer): Mr. Domer thanked everyone and stated that he is
  looking forward to the relationship with the Association.

  B. University Report (Zuhey Espinoza): Ms. Vallejo-Victoria announced that
  Homecoming will be held October 3-4.

  C. Chamber Report: Ms. Stark announced that the new CEO/Director of the Chamber
  started on Friday, August l't. The Chamber will also be seeking a part-time employee
  to assist in the office.

  D. Financial Report: None

7. PUBLIC COMMENT (Any discussion or action on non-agendized items must be
  deferred to the following meeting, as required by California Brown Act Law)

  Mr. Cannizzo stated that many of the American flags that were displayed for the Fourth
  of July are faded. Mr. Scherer will speak to the Public Works Director regarding the
  issue.

  Ms. Rehm asked for information regarding the Police Department's contract.

  Mr. Domer explained that even though the contract expired on June 30th it will continue
  during contract negotiations.

  Ms. Rehm stated that Wendy Norton has offered to help with the group's social media
  account.
 8. ADJOURNMENT
  The meeting was adjourned at 9:10am, the next regular meeting to be held on November
  3,2025 at 8:30 a.m. at Caf6 Wang -2316 D Street, La Verne CA 91750.

  Natalie Hiatt
